hero.label: About the hotel
hero.description: A place created around comfort, quiet moments, and the simple pleasure of feeling at home somewhere new.

story.label: Our story
story.sideText: Designed for people who appreciate the details.

how

story.paragraph1: We believe the best stays are rarely about one extraordinary moment. They are built from the small things: a room that feels right, a quiet morning, a warm welcome, and the feeling that everything has been taken care of.
story.paragraph2: Every part of the hotel is shaped around that idea — creating an environment where you can arrive, slow down, and simply enjoy being here.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.text: Spaces designed to make slowing down feel natural. From the first night to the last morning, everything begins with feeling at ease.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.text: Thoughtful service, genuine attention, and the freedom to enjoy your stay at your own pace.

atmosphere.title: Atmosphere
atmosphere.text: Warm materials, considered details, and quiet spaces come together to create an experience that stays with you.

experience.label: The experience
experience.description: Whether you are here for one night or several, our spaces are designed to give you room to breathe. Take your time. Explore at your own pace. Let the day unfold naturally.

cta.label: Your stay
cta.description: Find your space, choose your dates, and let your stay begin.
